images.prompt: Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot concept for a solo-developed low-poly 3D farm management survival game titled "밭이 줄어드는 세계". Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Orthographic three-quarter view of a small farm on a layered earthen cliff island in muted slate-blue sea with pale mist in the corners and scattered dark sea stacks and a tiny lighthouse. A 6x4 tile grid where 16 tiles remain; lost tiles shown as dashed empty outlines on the water. Warm green grass tops, angular ochre and brown strata cliff faces with white foam at their base, a compact wooden farmhouse with a smoking chimney and water barrel, autumn orange low-poly trees, fences, and crop plots of turnip, golden rye and sunflowers. Core mechanic: the front-right sunflower tile cracks and sheds falling earth chunks, a right-edge tile has a red dashed danger outline, two coast faces are protected by timber retaining walls, and an inland seedling plot is outlined in pulsing yellow. Flat shaded matte meshes, soft late-afternoon light, ambient occlusion. Dark navy rounded UI panels with clean Korean type: top left "밭이 줄어드는 세계", top center "남은 땅 16 / 24", top right "2년차 · 가을", right panel "침식 예보", bottom buttons "심기", "방벽 설치" (gold selected), "계절 넘기기".

Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot concept for a low-poly 3D farm management survival game titled "밭이 줄어드는 세계", at the season-turn erosion moment. Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same orthographic three-quarter view of the cliff-island farm in slate-blue sea with mist and sea stacks. Core mechanic: the front-right sunflower tile has broken off and is tilting and sinking into the sea, its cliff block cracking apart, angular earth chunks tumbling, a white ring splash and spray droplets around it; its former place now a red dashed empty outline; two neighboring tiles carry red dashed danger borders; timber walls still hold the other coasts. Farmhouse, rye and turnip plots remain intact, quiet and vulnerable. Matte flat-shaded low-poly style, soft overcast spring light, restrained melancholy, no explosion spectacle. UI: dark navy panels, a dark red event banner at top center, left panel listing what was lost, right erosion forecast minimap. Korean text: banner "한 칸을 바다가 가져갔습니다", HUD "남은 땅 15 / 24", "3년차 · 봄". Continuity with image A: the same 6x4-grid island, farmhouse, autumn-style trees and timber walls as image A with only the sunflower tile lost; HUD contains only the listed Korean texts plus a "잃은 것" panel; no resource counters (no 주민, 식량, 목재, 석재, 골드) and no extra toolbar.
